_readme: Supplier page details for Dental Business News, gathered 17 Nov 2026 from each company's own website (title, meta description, header logo). Where the site gave no usable logo, the logo is from the company's Wikimedia Commons file. dark:true means the logo is white and is shown on a dark tile. An empty website or logo means we could not confirm one: leave it empty rather than guess. Sector drives the filter on the hub.

Anglian Dental.line: Supplies dental chairs, designs and builds practices, and services and maintains surgery equipment.

Aura Infection Control.line: Supplies infection control products and decontamination services to dental practices.

Blake Morgan.line: Full service UK law firm advising businesses on employment, property and commercial law.

Carestream Dental.line: Makes dental imaging systems and practice software, from intraoral X-ray to CBCT.

Christie & Co.line: Business property adviser that buys, sells and values specialist businesses, including dental practices.

Dental Directory.line: Supplies dental and aesthetic products and services to UK dental practices.

Dental Elite.line: Dental consultancy offering practice valuations, sales, recruitment and practice finance.

Dental Protection.line: Dental protection organisation, part of the Medical Protection Society, supporting members with indemnity and advice.

HuFriedyGroup.line: Manufacturer of dental instruments and equipment, trading since 1908.

Locus.line: Location intelligence and site selection software for researching local markets before and after opening.

Mectron.line: Dental equipment maker whose dental unit HuFriedyGroup has bought.

Medenta.line: Provides patient finance and payment plans that dental practices offer for treatment.

NSK.line: Japanese manufacturer of dental handpieces and other dental equipment.

PFM Dental.line: Dental agency and consultancy handling practice sales, valuations and advice for buyers.

Practice Plan.line: Provides practice-branded dental membership plans for practices moving away from NHS dentistry.

Scott Bailey.line: Firm of solicitors based in Lymington, Hampshire.

Simplyhealth.line: Health plan provider offering dental plans and health cover to individuals and employers.

Wesleyan.line: Financial advice, pensions, savings and investments for doctors, dentists and teachers.
